problems_addressed.specific_problem: High rate of deals falling through after going under contract
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Implement the 30-day grip system to maintain client confidence and prevent deal fall-throughs.

clip_worthy_moments.quote: The deal you lose in escrow is actually the most expensive deal you'll ever lose. You already did the entire job. You just didn't get paid for it.

key_tactics.context: Call your client within 24 hours of mutual acceptance to outline the next month's process and potential stress points.
Every Tuesday, check in with all parties involved in the deal to ensure nothing is pending.
Proactively address potential deal-breaking moments like inspection results and appraisals by contacting clients first.

quotable_insights: The cheapest deal you win all year is the one you already have.
Going first is the entire thing. When you call your client with a problem, you're the professional running the deal.

episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris discusses the high rate of deals falling through after going under contract and introduces the '30-day grip' system to address this issue. By maintaining proactive communication with clients and other parties involved, agents can significantly reduce the number of deals that fail to close, ultimately saving time and resources.
